thread:
liya: Starting a small canary for v6q2 -> 3% traffic. Need to lock debounce + slice-weight policy so SRE won't flip on a blip.
enom: Quick post-start snapshot: overall winrate +0.1%, rerank slice -1.9% (but n=82), customer-A heavy skew.
patrick: rerank n=82 is tiny. longdoc has n=1.2k and shows slight uplift. Metrics look mixed.
rachel: My proposal: require 2/3 consecutive windows to trigger action. windows = 4m each. per-slice min_samples=150, global min_samples=500.
liya: Also want a critical-slice floor: if a critical slice breaches a high threshold we evaluate even if global weighted delta below min.
enom: Floor is useful but can be noisy for small slices. Maybe floor behaves only if slice_n >= 300?
patrick: Alternative: apply exponential smoothing across windows (alpha=0.4) to damp spikes, then compute weighted_quality_delta_smoothed.
rachel: Add immediate soft-degrade rule: if any critical slice delta >= 2.0% AND slice_n >= 300 -> soft-degrade to 40% traffic until next window check.
ops-bot: canary-start: v6q2 -> 3% traffic at ts=1794011111
squad-trust: We'll kick off a 500-sample human eval on longdocs focused on hallucinations and factuality.
liya: Good. Human eval + per-customer breakdown so Support can triage top-impacted accounts.
enom: I'll add per-customer slice view and temporary rate caps for top-5 affected customers.
patrick: Regarding auto-promote: auto-escalate to review channel if weighted_delta_smoothed <= -1.2% for 30m, but require manual signoff to actually promote.
rachel: Ops runbook outline: soft-degrade -> wait 10m -> re-evaluate. If still bad then hard-fallback. Pager only on hard-fallback.
liya: Final config summary to apply:
- windows: 4m
- hysteresis: 2 consecutive windows
- smoothing_alpha: 0.4
- min_slice_samples: 150 (critical immediate floor requires n>=300)
- min_global_samples: 500
- critical_slice_floor_weight: 0.4
- critical_immediate_threshold: 2.0% (with n>=300) -> soft-degrade 40% for 10m
- soft-degrade -> hard-fallback path, pager on hard-fallback
- auto-promote: alert-only, manual signoff required
- notify: #squad-trust + oncall

enom: :thumbsup:
patrick: :thumbsup:
rachel: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: canary-config-applied ts=1794011422
